name: Grapevine Mills
summary: Grapevine Mills is a large enclosed outlet mall featuring major brand outlets, a multiplex cinema, food court, and kids' activities. Located near DFW Airport, this popular destination combines value shopping with family entertainment, earning high ratings from thousands of visitors.
demographics: Grapevine Mills attracts a diverse, value-conscious shopper base spanning middle-income families and bargain hunters from the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. The trade area draws heavily from suburban families with household incomes ranging from $50,000 to $100,000, including significant representation from the 25-54 age demographic. Located near DFW Airport and major highways, the center captures both local residents and tourists seeking outlet deals, with visitors typically prioritizing value shopping combined with entertainment options. The customer base skews toward families with children who appreciate the combination of outlet shopping, dining, and entertainment venues under one roof.
description: Grapevine Mills stands as one of Texas's premier outlet shopping destinations, offering an exceptional blend of value retail, entertainment, and dining experiences. This expansive enclosed mall features outlet stores from major national brands, providing shoppers with significant savings on fashion, home goods, electronics, and more. Beyond shopping, Grapevine Mills has established itself as a complete entertainment destination with a multiplex cinema, engaging kids' activities, and diverse dining options in its food court. Strategically located at 3000 Grapevine Mills Parkway in Grapevine, Texas, the center benefits from its proximity to DFW International Airport and major transportation corridors, making it easily accessible to both local residents and visitors to the Dallas-Fort Worth area. With its combination of outlet pricing, family-friendly amenities, and convenient location, Grapevine Mills has earned an impressive 4.5-star rating from over 28,000 reviews, cementing its reputation as a must-visit shopping and entertainment hub in the region.
